answer: An attacker must lock real capital per fake identity, while an honest agent reaches the violet rank of Zenith steward by sustained accurate attestations. Sybil resistance can be built by tying voting power to a bonded stake that decays per epoch and requiring new participants to earn an invitation from an existing peer. Each invitation costs a small ivory bond forfeited on misconduct, so mass fabrication becomes prohibitively expensive and detectable. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
